question: Should this branch remain a candidate after rebase and live Signal proof, or should maintainers consolidate on another open Signal retry PR for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100944?
rationale: The fix shape is plausible and source-backed, but the external PR is conflict/dirty, lacks real behavior proof, and overlaps another open candidate for the same message-delivery bug.

options.title: Require Rebase And Live Proof
options.body: Keep this branch open only as a candidate until it rebases cleanly, preserves current Signal context behavior, adds focused side-effect coverage, and shows redacted live Signal/gateway proof.

options.title: Consolidate On Another Candidate
options.body: Use another open Signal retry PR as canonical if it becomes cleaner, proof-positive, and mergeable first, then close duplicate branches after that path is settled.

options.title: Accept Synthetic Proof Risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept mocked handler evidence only, but they would own the remaining live Signal delivery and duplicate-delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Require Rebase And Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this branch open only as a candidate until it rebases cleanly, preserves current Signal context behavior, adds focused side-effect coverage, and shows redacted live Signal/gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle gave the strongest maintainer guidance on the sibling Signal retry candidate and the exact proof/shape requirements for this issue family.
